Web search results for query: "Claude Code --worktree default directory .claude/worktrees"

Links: [{"title":"code.claude.com","url":"https://code.claude.com/docs/en/worktrees"},{"title":"claude code worktree setup guide","url":"https://verdent.ai/guides/claude-code-worktree-setup-guide"},{"title":"git worktrees claude code","url":"https://codewithmukesh.com/blog/git-worktrees-claude-code/"},{"title":"Claude Code Worktrees: Run Parallel Sessions Without Conflicts","url":"https://www.morphllm.com/claude-code-worktrees"},{"title":"2026 02 20 claude code worktree","url":"https://www.heyuan110.com/posts/ai/2026-02-20-claude-code-worktree/"},{"title":"code worktree","url":"https://www.verdent.ai/guides/claude/code-worktree"},{"title":"[FEATURE] Configurable default worktree directory","url":"https://claudeissues.com/issue/28242-feature-configurable-default-worktree-directory"},{"title":"worktree guide","url":"https://claudefa.st/blog/guide/development/worktree-guide"},{"title":"Claude Code Worktrees: Parallel Sessions Without Conflicts","url":"https://pilot-shell.com/blog/worktree-guide"}]

The default location is `.claude/worktrees/<name>/` under the repository root. Running `claude --worktree <name>` creates that directory and a new branch named `worktree-<name>`. The official docs say to put worktrees somewhere else, configure a WorktreeCreate hook.

- **Naming:** If you omit the name, Claude generates one such as bright-running-fox.
- **Base branch:** Worktrees branch from the remote default branch, and fall back to your current local HEAD if no remote is configured or the fetch fails. Setting worktree.baseRef to "head" changes this to local HEAD.
- **Trust prompt:** Before using --worktree interactively in a directory for the first time, accept the workspace trust dialog.
- **Gitignore:** Sources recommend adding `.claude/worktrees/` to `.gitignore` so worktree contents don't show up as untracked files.
- **Configurable path:** A GitHub feature request on claudeissues.com asked for a `worktreeDir` setting, since Claude Code hardcodes the worktree location to .claude/worktrees/<name>. The issue is marked closed, but the results don't confirm whether such a setting shipped. The official docs point to the WorktreeCreate hook instead.
